quote: We propose an approach for interactive classification, where the system can inquire missing information through a sequence of simple binary or multi-choice questions when users provide underspecified natural language queries.
datasets: FAQ dataset from Sprint's technical website

quote: We evaluate classification performance using Accuracy@k, which is the percentage of time the correct target appears among the top-k predictions of the model.
For human evaluation, users interact with our systems and baseline models using a web-based interactive interface.
guideline: The user answers the following questions: 'how natural is the interaction?' and 'do you feel understood by the system during the interactions?' on the scale of 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree), which we record as naturalness and rationality.
